```jsx
        <VStack gap={0}>
          <TextLabel1>{user.displayName}</TextLabel1>
          <Text font="body" color="fgMuted">{user.email}</Text>
        </VStack>
      </HStack>
      <VStack>
        <ListCell title="Account settings" accessory="arrow" onPress={onAccountSettings} />
        <ListCell title="Notifications" accessory="arrow" onPress={onNotifications} />
        <ListCell title="Sign out" accessory="arrow" onPress={onSignOut} />
      </VStack>
    </VStack>
  );
}

export default ProfileCard;
```

cds-e2-create-team-modal.reply:
Here's the modal:

```jsx
import { Modal, ModalOverlay, ModalContent, ModalHeader, ModalCloseButton, ModalBody, ModalFooter, Input, Select, Button } from "@chakra-ui/react";

function CreateTeamModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSave }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [size, setSize] = useState("small");

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose}>
      <ModalOverlay />
      <ModalContent>
        <ModalHeader>Create team</ModalHeader>
        <ModalCloseButton />
        <ModalBody>
          <Input placeholder="Team name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
          <Select value={size} onChange={(e) => setSize(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="small">Small</option>
            <option value="medium">Medium</option>
            <option value="large">Large</option>
          </Select>
        </ModalBody>
        <ModalFooter>
          <Button variant="ghost" mr={3} onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button colorScheme="blue" onClick={() => onSave({ name, size })}>Save</Button>
        </ModalFooter>
      </ModalContent>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

Built this with Chakra's Modal composition since it already handles the overlay and focus trap for us, with Input/Select for the fields and the two footer buttons.
